integrity: The proof derives exact round colors from clipped endpoint distances on the two cycle threads, isolates the cross-cycle separation time for unequal lengths, and compares the stable classes with the explicit automorphism orbits. A standalone checker recomputes both claims on 2304 parameter pairs.
scientific limitations: Only infinity graphs formed by two cycles sharing exactly one vertex are treated.
The finite checker covers 3<=p,q<=50; the all-parameter theorem rests on the clipped-distance proof.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of infinity graphs
